items.rootCause: HistoryLoader kept one list of server games for both 'הכל' and 'מדורג', and the server had no way to send rated games only. Under 'מדורג', fillRanked stopped fetching once rankedGames.length (all server games, friends games included) reached the card count, and the filter (inFilter) removed the friends games only afterwards. Moshe's QA phone has hundreds of friends games between 9 Nov and the older rated games, so each 'עוד משחקים' tap fetched one more page of friends games and showed nothing new, while hasMore stayed true. The loader also had no guard against overlapping reads. A tap on another filter, or onEndReached, during a read started a second loop on the same cursor, which asked for the same page twice and added its games twice. Every filter shared that one list and its reads, which fits the 'הכל' button that stopped answering. I could not reproduce the one-minute stall itself on the device side.
items.fix:
Server (old apps unchanged): GET /v1/me/games now takes an optional '&rated=1' (protocol HISTORY_RATED_PARAM and myGamesPath()). With it, listUserGames leaves out games.mode 'friends', and the keyset cursor works the same as before. Without it, the answer is exactly as before.
App: HistoryApi.myGames(cursor, {rated}). HistoryLoader now keeps two separate server lists: 'all' for 'הכל' and 'rated' (asked with rated=1) for 'מדורג'. Each list counts only the games its own filter shows. A read of a list waits for that list's page already in flight instead of asking for it again. Each read builds the snapshot for its own filter and count. If the server is older and ignores rated=1, the loader still filters the friends games out and keeps reading, up to MAX_PAGES_PER_READ = 10 pages per tap. As a result, 'עוד משחקים' always adds cards or disappears, and switching filters never waits for another filter's reads.

items.rootCause: There were two causes, both in PiratesLabScreen. (1) The tap's commit held both the button highlight (setDigit) and the 'gone' step, which deletes every avatar of the old character: about 2,600 SVG shapes plus the stage's idle layers. So the highlight reached the screen only after that deletion was mounted. (2) Two frames later, the 'still' step drew the whole new character in one commit. That is 28 pictures: the 96 px stage, 64, 36 and 22 px, and the 20-face expression grid. That comes to about 2,450–2,700 shapes (the Cabin Girl and the Parrot Keeper have the most), each parsed in JS (28 new markups per switch, more than the 96-entry AST cache) and created as a react-native-svg view on the UI thread. The stage had to wait for all of them, including the grid far below the fold. While that one large mount ran, the next tap also waited, so the highlight lagged 0.6–1.2 s when the tester tapped every 0.8 s. Each step also re-rendered the whole screen: 81 board cells and about 30 buttons. The no-flood fix (B32 SwitchStep plus the Reanimated patch) was not the problem, and it is kept.

'faces-{look}-{n}': two expressions at a time (FACES_PER_STEP = 2, at most about 290 shapes). 'live': it moves (shapes still draw before any layer moves). No commit draws more than about 300 shapes. A tap mid-switch again changes only the highlight. Tapping back on the character still drawn cancels the switch (chooseCharacter). New pure helpers: SWITCH_STEPS, partDrawn, nextSwitchStep, chooseCharacter. BoardMock is now memo, and the expression and motion buttons moved into a memo FaceButtons component, so the steps do not re-render the board's 81 cells or the 20 buttons.
